surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, low-frequency dark-pixel clusters distributed across the anterior and central dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary skin tone and subtle pigmented patches.

dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear scar patterns and superficial rake marks on the posterior dorsal surface.
